about_the_game:
Take on adventure in turn-based dungeon crawler featuring 20 different storylines in procedurally generated environments, over 200 unique monsters, and dynamic class customization. Choose from three classes: Fighter, Mage or Rogue, but customize your character on the fly as every class can learn any spell or skill. Explore dangerous dungeons filled with traps, logical puzzles, and powerful artifacts while facing unpredictable game goals. Play solo or team up in local couch co-op to tackle two-player puzzles and battle hordes of enemies.

STORYLINES

In Scaledeep, the core engine powering every descent into its ever-shifting depths is our Storylines. Self contained narrative arcs that give each run a clear purpose. You won’t just wander an endless labyrinth or chase some fix win condition; instead, each playthrough begins with a freshly chosen tale that unfolds against randomly generated corridors, traps, and lairs. Whether you’re delving into cursed catacombs to find the lost expedition or hunting down a legendary relic to save a besieged village (or for your own gain), every Storyline brings its own cast of characters, objectives, and surprising twists - so no two dungeon runs ever feel alike.

At the start of every run, you’re presented with the Storyline Selector, a magical book that picks one of twenty stories to set your goal. A short description appears - presenting you with your current goal. Once your story is chosen, the dungeon shifts to match: you’ll meet new encounters, find specific treasures, and trigger special events tied to that tale.

HOW TO LIVE

Pick your Hero archetype:

  • Warrior: when you just want to smash things with raw muscle

  • Mage: if you’d rather blast foes with powerful spells.

  • Rogue: for players who love sneaking, backstabs, and quick getaways.

Learn your craft

  • Blacksmith: Repair, mend, and reinforce your battered weapons and armor.

  • Arcane Reforger: Salvage enchantments from gear and weave those magics into your favorite weapon or armor.

  • Recharger: Recharge your weapons of missing charges.

  • Disenchanter: Strip enchantments from your loot into fine arcane powder to supercharge your own spells.

  • Alchemist: Mix up explosive potions, bombs, and potent elixirs

  • Trapmaker: Tear down spare loot for raw materials, then rig up snares and explosive devices.

Explore and Scavenge

  • Secret: Some walls hide locked, illusionary, or even slide-away doors.

  • Loot Everything: Carry it now, tear it apart later if it isn’t useful.

  • Environmental Hazards: Lure enemies over spike pits, into acid pools, push them in lava or abyss.

Team Up

  • Couch Co-Op with a friend. Grab controllers, and solve current storyline side by side.

HOW TO DIE

Who said death ends the story? In our game it’s merely the punchline of your wildest session. A tribute to the "famous last words":

  • Drown in the murky depths of a cave lake - "This scroll of random teleport seems foolproof."

  • Open Things You Shouldn’t - “Locks are just suggestions, anyway.”

  • Break Your Neck falling through a hidden trapdoor, or by jumping into the abyss - "Watch me dive baby!"

  • Die of Plague after poking those peaceful zombies -  “They look… a bit sniffly, but how bad can it be?”

  • Get Possessed by the Lich Lord - "Hmmm...is this phylactery worth any gold?"

  • Read a Very Very Cursed Book - “Knowledge is power!"

  • Get Bashed to Death by an very large cave troll - “He seems friendly enough - wanna hug buddy?”

  • Burn to Death - "A nice place for camp, near this patch of dry grass."

…and many more yet to be discovered.

Death is inevitable, but it doesn’t have to be boring. Can you find them all?
